failedAssertions.reason: Engine does not enforce four capacity rules the contract names. `rsv_service_availability.online_cap_per_interval` and `.concurrent_covers_cap`, `rsv_pacing_rules.rolling_min`/`rolling_max_covers` and `rsv_tables.reset_buffer_min` are referenced nowhere outside `packages/tenant-db/src/schema.ts` (only the seed script writes the first two; only the tenant-db schema test names the third), and the engine input models have no fields for them (`packages/reservations/src/engine/pacing.ts:3-29`, `engine/day-state.ts:60-130`); the only buffer applied is the location-level `settings.bufferMin` (`engine/availability.ts:461`). Invariant I3 overbook semantics are not honoured: `architecture.md:225-227` says overbook rows count as occupying their tables, but `OccupancyIndex` skips every `overbook` entry in all lookups (`engine/occupancy.ts:94,127,139,165`) and the test oracle skips them too (`testing/oracle.ts:233`). `alternatives()` returns same-day slots only (`engine/availability.ts:218,724`) where `architecture.md:1181` defines `{ sameDay, otherDates }` and the contract evidence asks for other dates. Working and asserted (engine suite 19/19, exit 0): per-slot pacing covers/parties incl. per-area windows and per-service online covers, min notice / same-day cutoff / horizon / release, party limits, channel-mode exclusions, expired-hold skipping, experience caps.

Property and scale suites run green (4/4 tests, numRuns 300/100, zero counterexamples; scale fixture 120 tables / 80 combinations / 900 bookings enforces the 200 / 2,000 / 5,000 expansion budgets and returns `no_fit` on exhaustion), but invariants I1-I8 are not verified with the semantics the contract and `architecture.md:216-239` define: there is no search-then-hold agreement check, no monotonic-release check, no atomic-modify check and no staff-overbook isolation check. `verifyDayInvariants` attaches the I6/I7/I8 labels to pacing caps, channel/mode eligibility and service-window checks (`testing/oracle.ts:76-199,229-261`), and the oracle comparison runs once per scenario rather than per step. This is the same gap as scrutiny round-2 blocking issue #2, which the orchestrator folded into `foh-setup-full-stack`; recorded as failed here so a pass is not silently accepted.

All five documents exist and are non-empty (ADR 048 is 286 lines; `docs/reservations.md`, `docs/reservations-contract.md`, `docs/reservations-plan.md` are 67-80 lines; `docs/permissions.md` lists the 8 permissions at lines 198-205 and the 6 flags at 256-261), but the ADR covers only 9 of the 11 topics the contract enumerates: it has no content for `guest identity without login` (no capability-token / manage-link / OTP wording anywhere; section 3 documents only the customer Bearer-JWT path) and none for the `shared org alarm` (section 9 mentions in-process timers and Durable Object alarms for the reservations tick only, never a generic per-organization alarm shared with staffing). Secondary documentation drift (non-existent trigger names in section 5, `24 rsv_* tables` vs 41, implied-read rules, preset count) was already reported by scrutiny as non-blocking and belongs to the same docs fix.
